name: Ridge Rider Campground
evidence: satellite (Esri, 1 km frame) at 39.6320,-78.3909: RV loops climb the wooded hillside N of Green Forest Dr; the creek runs along the road below the loops and the operator reserves the creekside spots for pop-ups/tents; no RV pad legibly at the water

name: Hillcrest River Campground
evidence: satellite (Esri, 800 m frame) at 39.6669,-78.7344: open hilltop field beside the I-68 exit 45 interchange; only water is a small pond at the S edge that the host says is decorative (no fishing), with no pads on it; the 'River' in the name is the host's separate primitive Canal Tunnel River site 3 mi away
